name: Cloudlet
notes: Smaller Cloud Puff from the split (own file, like doughling.json; it was a variants entry with stats TODO). Two Cloudlets together have about as much Health as one Cloud Puff, and hit a little softer. Never splits again. Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
tell: tiny puff, then small red circle
description: A small cloud that split from a Cloud Puff.

bestiary.tip: Small and quick. Calm them first.

lore.brown-black: Two little clouds, still a bit stormy. Calm them, and they float away together.
